Hi everyone, in my last visa A5 renewal (non-married), our clerk said that if we get married before our next appointment, I will be able to apply for citizenship, and recommended us that we check the Utah option. We didn't get details on that, but I heard recently that you need to register your marriage in your country of origin before that appointment, is that correct?(different people say different things, not here in the group) I did't have that information and I don't know if it is accurate... I need to know mainly because that could take several months. 

Thanks!
